description: A ground-level photograph captures a natural wetland environment. The foreground features a body of water with a uniform greenish-brown, turbid appearance. Along the far bank, a dense, vibrant band of tall, bright green emergent vegetation, consistent with reeds or tall grasses and sedges, grows directly from the water. This vegetation extends into the water from the shoreline. Behind this aquatic vegetation, a thick growth of darker green deciduous bushes and trees forms a dense backdrop, indicating a vegetated bank or forest edge. This image serves as a typical representation of a wetland environment, likely a reed-covered wetland along a river side or a freshwater marsh, aligning with Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) definitions for wetland categories.
